title: Up And Up
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Fixing up car to drive in it again
Searching for the water, hoping for the rain
Up and up, Up and up
Down upon canvas, working with wheel
Waiting for chance to pick your orange peel
Up and up, Up and up
See performer, diamond in the rough
See bird soaring high above the flood
It's in your blood, It's in your blood
Underneath the storm an umbrella is saying
Sitting with the poison takes away the pain
Up and up, Up and up
We're gonna get it, get it together
I know we're gonna get it, get it together somehow
We're gonna get it, get it together and flow
We're gonna get it, get it together
I know, we're gonna get it, get it together and flow
We're gonna get it, get it together and go
Up and up and up
Drowning in the study emptying the moon
Trying to empty out the ocean with spoon
Up and up, Up and up
How can people suffer? How can people part?
How can people struggle? How can people break your heart?

[bridge]
Yes I wanna know, show me how to feel
Yes I wanna go, show me how to heal it up
I healed it up
I'm trying to see the forest staring at every seed
Angels in the marble waiting to be free
Just need love, just need love
When the going is rough, saying
We're gonna get it, get it together
I know we're gonna get it, get it together somehow
We're gonna get it, get it together and flow
We're gonna get it, get it together
I know, we're gonna get it, get it together and flow
We're gonna get it, get it together and go up

[chorus]
You can change minds, take the risk
Or see each soul like happiness
